name: ProgressBar
description: A labelled progress bar whose fill springs to each new value with a glowing leading edge, a sheen sweeping along it, and a percentage that counts with it.
a11yNotes: Uses role="progressbar" with aria-valuemin/max/now and an aria-valuetext percentage, labelled by its visible label. The animated readout is aria-hidden so values aren't announced mid-animation. Reduced motion jumps straight to the value and removes the sheen.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Label above the bar; empty hides the header label.

propsApi.name: stiffness
propsApi.description: Spring stiffness; lower is bouncier and slower.

propsApi.name: autoPlay
propsApi.description: Demo mode: cycle through sample values.
